criteria.elbow: Smallest observed k with validation KL <= best validation KL + max(0.001, 0.10*abs(best validation KL)). At each k choose class by validation KL; ties use affine, gru, tanh, hmm. Apply the same rule separately within each class.
criteria.adequate_fit: Selected validation AND paired test KL <= 0.001 nats. Test is assessment only, never selection.
criteria.geometry: At the selected k, both forward and reverse MLP R2 >= 0.95 for the task target: quotient for Reward-State Quotient policy, factor_1 for Marginal Reward policy, full belief otherwise. Trivial Quotient policy at k=0 requires no belief geometry.
criteria.recovered: Complete four-class scientific k grid, adequate fit, selected k equals the stated task dimension, and geometry criterion passes.
criteria.partially_recovered: Not recovered, but adequate fit OR >=90% paired test-KL reduction relative to the validation-selected constant (k=0) predictor.
criteria.not_recovered: Neither recovery nor partial-recovery criteria established. Missing fits are pending evidence, NOT evidence of non-recoverability.
criteria.condition_verdict: Recovered only if all three policy seeds AND all three control seeds recover; partially recovered if any row recovers or partially recovers; otherwise not recovered (pending where data are absent). Any incomplete row makes the condition verdict provisional.
criteria.diagnostics: Commutation and HMM T/E agreement are descriptive, not gates: affine commutation is coordinate-dependent, and an MLP head does not ensure parameter identifiability. Quotient comparisons outside Reward-State Quotient are counterfactual.

caveats: Missing fits are not imputed. All incomplete-sweep selections and verdicts are provisional.
Policy imitation dimension need not equal environmental task-sufficient dimension: the trained policy may retain history/nuisance dependence.
KL is nats per position (controls average equally over current actions); every fit uses complete held-out episodes.
R2 and commutation are descriptive held-out probes, not evidence of causal use. No uncertainty is invented from aggregate metrics.
The descriptive minimum test KL across classes is not used in any selection.
